plan.what: FlagAllHeroes to the party's own flag position, then UnflagAllHeroes
FlagHero for one hero, then UnflagHero
SetHeroBehavior with a different value for one hero, then back
SetSkillAIEnabled on one slot, then back
SetHardMode/SetNormalMode, in an outpost, then back
SearchParty with a short advertisement, then SearchPartyCancel
SetPetBehavior(Fight, current target) — needs a living enemy target — then back
Heroes.UseSkill on one hero number and slot (`--hero-number`, `--slot`)
AddHeroByName (`--hero`), and AddHenchman when `--henchman <agent_id>` is given — **changes the party**, outposts only
KickHeroByName (`--hero`), and KickHenchman with `--henchman` — **changes the party**
LeaveParty — **changes the party**, and only with someone else in it

note: act stage: only the named steps ran, and each reversible one was put back — after waiting, bounded, for the client to show the change it was sent ('settled'), because the client applies a party change when it processes the command and a restore computed before that lands replaces the value it meant to keep. The steps that change the party or leave the map are the owner's call, one at a time — and each refuses here when the client's own condition for it is not met (no such hero, a party of one, not an outpost).
